units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 8:6">Sot. VIII, 6</cite>, a. e. v. <cite ref="N00702"><he>נִיסָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 5:7">B. Kam. V, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Kamma 54b:6">54ᵇ</cite>) <he>לנְפִילַת הבור</he> as to the laws relating to an animal falling into a pit (<cite ref="Exodus 21:33">Ex. XXI, 33</cite> sq.).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:5:14">Y. Ber. I, 3ᵈ</cite> top <he>שתסמכנו מנְפִילָתֵנוּ</he> that thou mayest support us in our downfall.—Pl. <he>נְפִילוֹת</he>.
Yalk. Esth. 1058 (ref. to Esth. VI, 13) שתי נ׳ הללו למה why this double use of nafal?

senses.gloss: (v. מַפּוֹלֶת) quantity of seed required for a field.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 5:1">Peah V, 1</cite> <he>נותן לעניים</he> (<cite ref="B00000"><he>ב</he></cite>) <he>כדי נ׳</he> (Y. ed. <he>נִפְלָהּ לעניים</he>) he must give to the poor as much as the field requires for seed (v. Maim. a. l.; oth. opin.: as much as is generally dropped at cutting); <cite ref="Bava Metzia 105b:12">B. Mets. 105ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 9:5">Ib. IX, 5</cite> <he>אם יש בה כדי נ׳</he> (Y. ed. <he>נִיפְלָהּ</he>) if the field yields as much as is required for seed, expl. Y. ib. 12ᵃ <he>כדי הזרע הנופל בה</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 5:1:7">Y. Peah. V, 18ᵈ</cite> <he>כדי ניפלת</he> (corr. acc.).—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Orlah 1:1:10">Y. Orl. I, 60ᵈ</cite> top <he>כדי נפילתה</he> R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Orlah 1:2">Orl. I, 2</cite>, v. <cite ref="I00655"><he>טְפִילָה</he></cite>.]
